### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/spec`, touching **5** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/liveness/page.json`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**2** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/protocol/objectui/layout-dsl.mdx`  _(via PageComponentSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_
- `content/docs/ui/pages.mdx`  _(via /api/v1/cloud/home (route, a path literal in ElementApiDataSourceSchema))_

⛔ **2** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v15.mdx`  _(via PageComponentSchema (symbol, a top-level const), PageTabsProps (symbol, a top-level const object))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-7.mdx`  _(via PageComponentSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/liveness/page.json`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **143** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 31ce45c071bbcb6e92a730ce19ebf30dcfa361cb` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `bbf5ea9185698eb385d8f6d6856cf087cd511b78` — the merge of head `f0ce6bc1e3f2ba0333eaa5709bb5c0c1ca263286` into base `31ce45c071bbcb6e92a730ce19ebf30dcfa361cb`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin bbf5ea9185698eb385d8f6d6856cf087cd511b78 && git checkout bbf5ea9185698eb385d8f6d6856cf087cd511b78
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 31ce45c071bbcb6e92a730ce19ebf30dcfa361cb f0ce6bc1e3f2ba0333eaa5709bb5c0c1ca263286 && git checkout -B drift-repro 31ce45c071bbcb6e92a730ce19ebf30dcfa361cb && git merge --no-ff f0ce6bc1e3f2ba0333eaa5709bb5c0c1ca263286

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 31ce45c071bbcb6e92a730ce19ebf30dcfa361cb
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 31ce45c071bbcb6e92a730ce19ebf30dcfa361cb` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `0ea4d853a264972a2444c52f3705f72013473f1b`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts + packages/spec/src/ui/expression-scope-data-root.pin.test.ts (the gate that enforces the rewritten rule), packages/spec/liveness/page.json, .changeset/24300-api-binding-rendered.md, content/docs/references/ui/page.mdx, content/docs/references/ui/component.mdx, content/docs/ui/pages.mdx, .objectui-sha, scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json, scripts/build-console.sh, sdui.manifest.json, .github/workflows/ci.yml (Console Pin Gate), packages/spec/src/shared/strict-object.ts, packages/spec/src/ui/app.zod.ts and content/docs/references/ui/app.mdx on `origin/main` after #24427; and at objectui `0707b4ae37`: packages/react/src/SchemaRenderer.tsx, packages/react/src/element-data-source/useElementApiDataSource.ts, packages/react/src/element-data-source/__tests__/useElementApiDataSource-12197.test.tsx, packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx, packages/components/src/renderers/layout/page.tsx, packages/components/src/renderers/layout/page-block-grid.tsx, packages/app-shell/src/console/blocks/productBlocks.tsx, packages/app-shell/src/providers/ExpressionProvider.tsx

Inputs read: card #24300 body and all 8 comments (triage `6249016520`, unlock `6250246512`, rider `6259026494`, claim `6259115316`, dev reports `6259974100` and `6260445006`, amendments `6259996449` and `6260050788`); PR #24460 body, its 8-file list and the net diff against the merge base `9112bcd887` (+203 / -91); the 48 check-runs on the head: 41 success, 7 skipped (Console Pin Gate, Dogfood matrix, Dogfood Verify CLI, Packed-tarball smoke, Temporal Conformance, and two skipped duplicates of Auto Label and Check PR Size), 0 failure. Every file below was read with `git show` at the head, at `origin/main`, or at the objectui pin; nothing was built, run or re-run.

### ① Derived judgments

Accept set: unchanged. RIGHT. The diff to `page.zod.ts` touches `surface`, `history`, `guidance.*` strings, `.describe()` strings, two `error:` message functions and TSDoc. `strict-object.ts` declares those options as message carriers only (`guidance`: prescriptions for keys the shape does not declare; `aliases` untouched); the shape, the `.strict()` closure, `SAME_ORIGIN_API_PATH_RE`, `ELEMENT_API_RESPONSE_PATH_RE` and the `z.literal('GET')` arm are byte-identical. Every refusal keeps its issue `code` and `path`. `check:api-surface`, `check:authorable-surface` and `check:strictness-ledger` ran green inside the required TypeScript Type Check job on the head. `component.zod.ts` changes one TSDoc paragraph and one `.describe()` parenthetical on the `page:tabs` item `visibleWhen`; no key moves.

Published prose, `ElementApiDataSourceSchema` describe and docblock (the card's class-b premise): RIGHT, each sentence measured at the pin. `.objectui-sha` is `0707b4ae37` on `origin/main` and at the merge base; `git merge-base --is-ancestor c4dd7078ed 0707b4ae37` in `/home/user/objectui` exits 0. `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json` records `objectuiSha` `0707b4ae37…` and `scripts/build-console.sh` builds at `.objectui-sha`, so the framework's own console is the one measured and no "which console" caveat is owed. At that pin: `useElementApiDataSource.ts:101` parses the binding with `ElementApiDataSourceSchema.safeParse` before any read and `refused` carries the schema's own issue messages joined (`:105`); the read is one `GET` with `Accept: application/json`, `credentials: 'include'` through `SchemaRendererContext.apiFetch` (`:146-167`); a non-2xx answer, a non-JSON body and a `path` that selects nothing each become `error` with a sentence naming which (`:155`, `:159`, `:210`). `SchemaRenderer.tsx:1157` calls the hook for every node (the hook's own docblock says "Called unconditionally … for every node"); `:1161` and `:1231` build `{ ...ambientScope, data: apiData }` once `ready`; `:1285` returns the working copy unevaluated while the binding is `loading`, `refused` or `error`, so holes and `visibleWhen` are decided only once the value is in; `:2165-2178` draw the loading panel or `ElementApiDataSourcePanel` before the `_hidden` test; `:2524` wraps the rendered node in `PredicateScopeProvider` with the subtree scope. Page regions reach `SchemaRenderer` through `page.tsx:229` and `page-block-grid.tsx:56`, so "on every page element" holds. The `stat`, `usage-bar` and `checklist` blocks (and `hero`, `tile-grid`) each declare `API_BINDING_INPUT` as their `dataSource` in `productBlocks.tsx:350-408`, so "built to take it" holds; the describe names three and `content/docs/ui/pages.mdx` names five, both true.

`PageComponentSchema.visibleWhen`, describe and TSDoc: RIGHT. The mounted-roots sentence is unchanged and still true: `buildExpressionScope` (`ExpressionProvider.tsx:181-191`) returns exactly `current_user`, `user`, `ctx.user`, `os.user`, `features`; `configEvaluationScope` (`SchemaRenderer.tsx:668`) adds `current_user`, `record` only when a row exists, and `page`. The new sentence "`data` is mounted only on an element whose `dataSource` is an `api` data source … there, and on every element nested inside it" matches `:1231` and `:2524`; "NO `data` root on an element that no `api` data source binds" matches the ruling-B comment block at `:1256-1263` and the untouched `ambientScope` pass-through at `:1145`. No root is claimed that is not mounted.

`page:tabs` item `visibleWhen`, both faces in `component.zod.ts` (claim amendment `6259996449`): RIGHT. `containers.tsx:645-651` builds the item evaluator as the row's bare fields, then `...predicateScope`, then `record: recordData` and `data: recordData` written after the ambient spread, so inside an `api`-bound element the item evaluator's `data` is still the row, as the TSDoc now says, while the component-node evaluator's `data` is the binding's value, as the parenthetical now says. The describe and TSDoc faces agree with each other and with `PageComponentSchema.visibleWhen`.

Rider `6259026494`, door-neutral refusal and strict-surface sentences: RIGHT, including the dev's declared step past its letter. `origin/main` `app.zod.ts:419` (merged in #24427 as `26501ae24f`) declares `dataSource: ElementApiDataSourceSchema.optional().describe(...)` by reference, so the navigation door now raises the same `read.url`, `method`, `path`, `body`, `write` and unknown-key messages; none of them names a page element any more. The `object` guidance is the one sentence that could not be made neutral by deletion alone: the navigation door admits no object binding, so "keep `object`" was false there; scoping it to "where the `dataSource` also takes the object binding (a page element's does)" is true on both doors. The navigation key keeps its own `[PLANNED — not yet rendered]` describe (the claim's hold-off), and `gen:docs` prints the key's describe rather than the inner schema's, so a navigation author does not read "the console renders it on every page element" on their door: `app.mdx` on `origin/main` carries no "API binding of a page element" sentence.

The pin, `expression-scope-data-root.pin.test.ts` (re-trued, 13 to 16 cases): RIGHT as the gate for the rewritten rule. Rule (2) now admits a `data` sentence that says NO `data`, ties it to `provider: 'api'`, or is about `page:tabs`; the DARK control at `:260` shows an overclaim without the binding still fails it, and the DARK control at `:273` shows each of the three replaced planned texts is caught by `PLANNED_READINGS`, so the three-text `toEqual([])` at `:227-235` is a reading and not a vacuous matcher. The new TSDoc assertion at `:189-195` anchors on "The one `data` this surface has" and requires `provider: 'api'`, `useElementApiDataSource` and the `objectui:` read point, all present in the head's docblock. The component twin at `:198-209` refuses the old "mounts no `data` root at all". The dev's one-shot reverse run (page.zod.ts restored to the base blob: 4 failed / 12 passed) is consistent with these matchers; I did not re-run it.

`liveness/page.json` `_note`: RIGHT. The PLANNED RECORD for #23016 becomes a LIVE RECORD measured at the pin with the three `objectui:` read points (`SchemaRenderer.tsx`, `useElementApiDataSource.ts`, `productBlocks.tsx`), each of which exists at `0707b4ae37`; the `regions` row that #24442 edited is untouched; the #23134 and #24266 PLANNED records stay as they were. Spec property liveness is green on the head.

Generated docs: RIGHT at the PR's base, INCOMPLETE against `origin/main` as of #24427, and the queue will say so. `page.mdx` and `component.mdx` are regenerated and `check:docs` reports 227 files in sync on the head. But #24427 landed after this PR's merge base and `gen:docs` now also expands `ElementApiDataSourceSchema`'s property describes into `content/docs/references/ui/app.mdx`: on `origin/main` that file carries the OLD `provider` / `read` / `path` describes ("Binds the element to one same-origin API endpoint instead of an object", "the same-origin endpoint the element binds", "the element binds the whole response") at 17 nested-shape sites (`:49-51`, `:388-390`, … `:1343-1345`). This PR's net diff cannot regenerate a file its base did not have the reference in, so after the merge `app.mdx` is stale until `gen:docs` runs again. `lint.yml` runs on `merge_group`, and `check:docs` sits in the required TypeScript Type Check job, so the queue refuses the stale artifact rather than landing it; it is a landing precondition, not a defect of this diff. Escalated in ③.

Sibling checkout: no pin risk. The Console Pin Gate (`ci.yml:2917-2990`) is skipped on `pull_request` and, when it runs, builds the console at the pin and asserts the dist bundles this tree's spec; it runs no objectui test. The one objectui test that reads the refusal text, `__tests__/useElementApiDataSource-12197.test.tsx:141` (the PR body cites it without the `__tests__/` segment, a citation slip, not a claim error), asserts only `same-origin`, which the new wording keeps. `git grep` at the pin finds no objectui test asserting "page element's `api`", "this element `api` data source", "A page element only reads" or "a page element's read".

Fence and hold-offs: honoured. `app.zod.ts` is untouched on the branch; the `[PLANNED — not yet rendered]` markers left in `component.zod.ts` at the head (`:1175` `emptyState`, `:1747` `parentDataSource`) are #24266's and #23134's; `page.zod.ts:855` and `:1965` keep the app-page `record` binding's own planned wording, a different key.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/24300-api-binding-rendered.md`: `@objectstack/spec` `patch`. RIGHT. What the diff publishes is describe text (the JSON schema `description` fields and the generated reference docs), the strict-surface and refusal message strings, and TSDoc; nothing an author can write is added, removed, renamed or re-typed, and no export changes (`check:api-surface`: unchanged). A describe and message correction in a released package is a fix, so `patch` and not `skip-changeset` is the floor and it is met.

Clause-②: `no` on the PR body and in the changeset body, with no `(widening)` / `(narrowing)` arm. RIGHT and consistent: the accept set is byte-identical (① above), and Check Changeset and `check:adr-0087-registration` are green on the head. No breaking marker or ADR-0087 disposition is owed.

One nit, not a verdict item: the changeset's bullets name the `ElementApiDataSourceSchema` describe, the `PageComponentSchema.visibleWhen` faces and the refusal messages, but not the `page:tabs` item `visibleWhen` describe parenthetical that patch round 2 also publishes. The level is unaffected; the dev already offered the one-line addition under `pr_body_edits_for_the_seat` and it stays the seat's call.

### ③ Boundary flags

Both dev reports carry `open_questions: []`. Every declared deviation and out-of-scope finding, and the two claim amendments, answered:

- Amendment `6259996449` (the `page:tabs` describe face): delivered in patch round 2, `component.zod.ts:984`, and judged RIGHT in ①. The PR body's first acceptance note is struck through accordingly.
- Amendment `6260050788` (`content/docs/ui/pages.mdx`, declared to `domain:devx` on #20163): the one "Not rendered yet" bullet becomes "Rendered by the console"; its five block names and its loading / error panel sentence are measured true at the pin (①). No other line of that page changes.
- Deviation "rider applied a little past its letter" (`object` guidance scoped to the door that takes an object binding): answered RIGHT in ①; it is the only reading true on both doors and it moves no code or path.
- Deviation "main not merged" (reported 5, then 10 commits behind): the merge is now owed, not optional. ESCALATED to the landing seat: before queueing, merge `origin/main` (which carries #24427 and #24442), run `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` then `check:generated --fix` (expected: only `content/docs/references/ui/app.mdx` stale, regenerated by `gen:docs`), and let the pin re-run. GitHub's `mergeable: clean` answers textual overlap only; `check:docs` in the queue answers this. Whether the merge-round head needs a fresh stamp is the seat's rule to apply; this record names `0ea4d853a2` and the generator-only additions the merge round is expected to carry.
- Deviation "`--maxWorkers=2` after a bare `--`": acknowledged by the dev as most likely discarded by vitest (AGENTS.md's own trap); the whole package ran and Test Core 1-6 of 6 are green on the head, so nothing rests on the local reading.
- Deviations "runner stopped and re-derived", "test:repo not run locally", "4 pushes", "attribution trailer per AGENTS.md", "check:dual-build-cjs-loads NOT MEASURED at the head (exit 3, read exit 0 at `8951d79063`)", "check:dev-prereqs refused its whole-workspace precondition": each is a local-run narrowing the head's check-runs cover (Build Core, Lint & Repo Gates and the Type Check lanes are green); none hides a finding.
- Out-of-scope finding, class a, `pnpm check:platform-checklist` exit 1 on `access-security.json:2823` (`legacyGrantAnchorRetired` moved to plugin-auth in `b2e78701f7`, #24373): independent of this diff (no file under `packages/core` or `docs/qa` is touched) and kept out of per-PR CI by `lint.yml:2607`. ESCALATED to the seat as its own card if none is open yet; the dev's dedupe words stand. Not a condition on this PR.
- Out-of-scope finding, carrier none, "the committed SDUI manifest lists none of the five product blocks": now MEASURED rather than inferred. `sdui.manifest.json` on `origin/main` (record `objectuiSha` `0707b4ae37…`, 107 component keys) has no `hero`, `stat`, `usage-bar`, `checklist` or `tile-grid` key, and `packages/lint/src/validate-jsx-pages.ts:60-62` compiles a JSX page against that manifest with unknown-component diagnostics. The describe, the `_note` and `pages.mdx` say these blocks are built to take the binding, which is true of the console at the pin, so the texts stay; but an author who follows them into a JSX page meets the framework's own gate. This predates the PR (the replaced text named the same three blocks). ESCALATED to the seat as a class-b card on the manifest generator's enumeration (`scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs`, the 16 registry modules) versus app-shell's console block registrations; dedupe words: sdui.manifest.json, productBlocks, hero stat usage-bar checklist tile-grid, validate-jsx-pages unknown component.
- Out-of-scope finding, carrier none, the docblock's "The ruling" section grounding `GET`-only in `@object-ui/core`'s `ApiDataSource`: outside the fence and still true of that adapter; the new section cites the shipped reader's own `GET`. No action.
- `pr_body_edits_for_the_seat`: the PR body as read already carries the round-2 bullets and the struck-through acceptance note; only the optional changeset addition (② nit) remains open.
